messages:
tara: FYI test found sampling + late enrichment causing billing attribution holes (unknown-tenant) for a tiny percent of traces. Need quick tradeoffs.

matt: any short repro?

tara: repro: trace t1 with spans A (has tenant), B (gets tenant via async kv after ingest), C. Sampling runs pre-enrich so B can be dropped. Later rehydration loses tenant.

alex: options: pre-enrich at edge (costly), push tenant token in SDK (breaking change), trace-level sampling, or keep a tiny metadata envelope for dropped spans to stitch later.

samir: minimal envelope seems pragmatic. How big & what TTL?

alex: rough: ~64-200B per entry depending on fields. If we retain for 5m at 100k/sec worst-case that becomes multi-GB. Feasible for Dedicated, heavy for Hosted.

matt: hybrid idea: only hold placeholders when tenant absent (defer-sample) for short TTL (10s default). If enrichment resolves within TTL we stitch; otherwise fall back and mark unknown. This reduces retention significantly.

tara: agreed. Add per-region TTL config (default 10s, allow up to 60s for slow regions). Also gate via per-tenant config: enterprise customers can opt into longer windows/prefix-cache.

ingest-bot: deploy-job: staged-prefix-placeholder-proto queued by matt at 2026-03-22T15:10Z

samir: metrics: gauge placeholders, counter rehydrated, counter unknown-at-query, histogram time-to-tenant. SLI idea: <=0.1% unknown for enterprise.

alex: add audit event when rehydrate happens: {event:"rehydrate", trace_id, tenant, region, latency_ms}. Document billing semantics: stitched attribution only valid within TTL; after TTL, billing shows unknown unless customer requests backfill.

matt: action items: prototype placeholder flow in gateway (PR by EOW), capacity calc for enterprise prefix-cache (alex), update dashboards (samir). Gate via observability.enable_placeholder and per-tenant overrides.

tara: thanks folks. I'll file a follow-up RFC after prototype. :thumbsup:
